name: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
summary: Jediga wants the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning kept from the blood elves. She sends you to Zevrost in Orgrimmar to have it deciphered.

sections.title: A Contact in Orgrimmar
sections.body: Jediga points you toward Zevrost, a warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow who can try to decipher the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning. You carry the tome to him, while Jediga fears the blood elves could use it to retaliate.

faq.answer: Zevrost is a warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow who can try to decipher the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning.

faq.q: Why does Jediga want the tome kept from the blood elves?
aliases: why not give it to blood elves
faq.answer: Jediga fears the blood elves could use the tome to retaliate.

faq.q: Where do I take the Sin'dorei Tome?
faq.answer: Jediga sends you to Zevrost in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

faq.q: What is the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning?
faq.answer: It is a tome Jediga wants kept out of the blood elves' hands and brought to Zevrost for deciphering.
Jediga sent you to Zevrost with the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning.
